title: Oil — Oil Filter Housing — Installation of the Rolled Edge Firewall Panel and Harness Re-Clipping
abstract: Installation of the rolled edge oil filter housing firewall panel and re-clipping of the engine harness, on engines that have been through more than two shop visits and may carry the panel in the alternate latch position.

sections.planning_reason: Three operators reported an oil quantity indication fault that cleared on the ground, and in each case the engine harness was found chafed where it crosses the oil filter housing firewall panel. Every affected engine had been through at least two shop visits and carried the panel in the alternate latch position permitted by the earlier drawing, which moves the panel edge four millimetres inboard onto the harness route. The chafing is slow, gives no warning until the shield is breached, and is not caught by the scheduled powerplant inspection.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin replaces the firewall panel with an item that has a rolled and radiused inboard edge and no alternate latch position, so the panel can only be refitted one way. The panel fastener washers are replaced to suit the thicker flange, and the engine harness is re-clipped one hundred millimetres further outboard. The seal and cowl latch are removed and refitted.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Make sure that the engine is cool and that the oil system is not pressurised. Open the fan cowl and remove the pylon lower access panel to reach zones 431, 421 and 413. Remove the existing firewall panel following task AMM-Z-79-20-12-000-035-A and record which latch position was fitted. Inspect the engine harness for chafing over the full length that crosses the panel and report any finding before you continue. Install the panel FJD382676-90 with the countersunk washers AES837153-84 at the six panel fasteners. Remove and refit the seal at FIN 14EO with a new seal element. Remove and refit the cowl latch at FIN 227EO. Re-clip the harness one hundred millimetres outboard of its previous route and confirm the clearance to the panel edge against drawings D79201225675 and D79201232627. Do an engine ground run and check the oil quantity indication through the full range.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable per engine to aircraft in the MSN Z03884 to Z10389 range. Engines delivered from the shop after the build standard change already carry the panel and are excluded. An earlier panel must not be refitted to a modified installation because the harness has been re-routed to the new clearance.
sections.material_note: Kit K7920-1007-01 covers one engine and contains the panel, the washer set, the seal element and the clip hardware. Two kits are required per aircraft. All items are short-lead.

type_data.compliance_time: Within 24 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, or at the next fan cowl opening of four hours or more, whichever occurs first.
